summary: Practise emotion regulation, feedback planning and conflict response with workplace scenarios. Explore the five-day advanced emotional intelligence course.
lede: Emotional intelligence helps people notice and interpret emotional cues, then choose considered responses at work. Designed for supervisors, team leads and workplace professionals, the course applies these skills to decisions, feedback and conflict. You’ll practise recognizing triggers, regulating responses, checking interpretations and planning listening and feedback conversations through guided workplace scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who regularly manage emotionally charged conversations, assess interpersonal cues or support others through change. It is designed for professionals seeking an applied foundation in emotional intelligence, including those without prior formal assessment training.
prerequisites: Workplace experience involving team interaction, feedback or service conversations is useful. No prior emotional intelligence assessment training or coding is required.
